They have saved her life, it's that simple. She's been through a tough time in 2024 in particular and all the doctors have supported her incredibly well. Dr Pillitteri initiated emergency treatment at Arrowe Park, thank you so much. Dr Wright and Dr Patrick (who identified a DVT in my wife's leg) have also been a massive help with home visits and returning phone calls. Dr Carter has also been extremely helpful with advice and the admin team have also responded very swiftly to online requests or queries. I would strongly recommend using the PATCHS system, it works. We should be very grateful to have Drs like this in Greasby, so please support them. Remember also, they are like us, with families, and lives to live with all its day-to-day pressures. Being a GP is a huge responsibility and pressure and we need to consider that, so give them time and space to do their work.
